svg.title: Lost in the Middle at a glance
svg.desc: Six panels: the question; two tasks (multi-document QA and key-value retrieval); two dials (position and length) and the accuracy meter; the U-shaped result for GPT-3.5-Turbo with 20 documents (75.8% at the start, 53.8% in the middle, 63.2% at the end, 56.1% closed-book); four suspected causes with verdicts; and five lessons for engineers.
svg.text: Lost in the Middle (Liu et al., 2023): the paper at a glance
Two tasks, two dials, one U-shaped result, four suspects, and the lessons for engineers.
• JSON object of random UUID pairs: 75, 140 or 300
